title: Episode 2 — Learn Arabic for Beginners: Full Course

intro.title: What you'll learn
intro.line: In this lesson you'll ask yes or no questions, slow down a fast waiter, learn the days of the week, make plans, answer the questions every Arab asks, have a full conversation, and learn colors, food and jobs, all in Arabic.

chapters.title: Yes or no questions
chapters.line: First, one little word that turns any sentence into a yes or no question.

chapters.title: When Arabic is too fast
chapters.line: Next, three lifesaver phrases for the moment when Arabic is too fast for you.

chapters.title: Do you speak Arabic?
chapters.line: Now the question every Arab asks when they hear your accent, and the perfect answer to it.

chapters.title: Days of the week
chapters.line: Next, the days of the week, with a secret that makes them easy to remember.

chapters.title: Making a plan
chapters.line: With the days of the week in your pocket, let's make a plan with a friend.

chapters.title: Questions about you
chapters.line: Next, the questions people will ask about you, and how to answer every one of them.

chapters.title: A full conversation: you are Sami
chapters.line: Now a whole conversation, and you play Sami. Lina speaks first, you answer in the pause, and then you hear Sami's answer.

chapters.title: The same conversation with a woman
chapters.line: Now switch roles. This time you are Lina, so listen for the small changes when Sami talks to a woman.

chapters.title: Inshallah and habibi
chapters.card: Inshallah and habibi: what they really mean
chapters.line: Next, two words you will hear from Arabs every single day, and what they really mean.

chapters.title: Colors
chapters.line: Now ten colors, with a little trick hidden in four of them.

chapters.title: Food
chapters.line: Next, ten food words from the Arab table.

chapters.title: Jobs
chapters.line: And now twenty jobs, so you can answer the question about what you do.

chapters.title: English words from Arabic
chapters.line: To finish the words, here are ten English words that secretly come from Arabic.

chapters.title: The big conversation
chapters.line: Now everything together: one long story, all in Arabic, with the English on screen.
